findings.reproduction: 600x320; A supplies house+alley+pump, B park; trip A, move pump to B and cool. Click A center at (162,84).
findings.title: Feeder center click selects a passing editable wire instead of the feeder
findings.actual: Selects 02 / 골목 ↔ A / 주택 회선 and offers 연결 끊기, not 회선 복구. The fixture then clicked that explicit delete button and removed a normal wire; this was not automatic deletion.
findings.expected: Clicking the feeder body must reliably select its fixed circuit/recovery action, prioritizing the feeder body over nearby/passing wires.
findings.cause: pointerdown resolves closestWire before the feeder-body branch.

findings.title: Selected healthy feeder recovery button stays disabled after trip
findings.actual: Select fixed A edge while healthy: disabled true. Advance 6.05s into real trip: tripped true, popup visible, disabled still true.
findings.expected: Refresh selected fixed-feeder action when protection state changes; keep actual unsafe reset guard.
